title: Patch: the fuzz gate probes playing through an open prompt
thread:
**Issue #2829 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2829: Patch: the fuzz gate probes playing through an open prompt
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The fuzz gate plays thousands of random games and also sends forged illegal actions to make sure the engine refuses them with the game untouched. Today it never tries the simplest illegal move of all: playing a card, or ending the turn, while a question is still open. After this change it does, so an engine slip that accepts such a move fails loudly at the exact step.
## Why
While a prompt is open the engine refuses everything but its answer and game-ending actions (`reduce.rs`: a prompt blocks every action but its own answer and the ones that end a game, §9.3, R79; BUILD M1-T3). But `probe_state` in `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` only forges a reused nonce, a wrong seat, malformed answers and malformed actions, and `malformed_actions` in `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` only forges variants of a Play choice, so when a prompt is open (the chosen action is an Answer) no non-answer probe is ever sent. Invariants I7 (orphaned work) and I10 (opponent-held prompts) do not check this refusal either.
## Proposal
Add one probe to `probe_state`: while a non-mulligan prompt is open, forge the seat's non-answer action (a Play when its hand holds one, else EndTurn) with a fresh nonce, owed a refusal with no events and an unchanged state, through the existing `judge_probe` machinery. Reuse `malformed_actions` shapes where they fit; keep the mulligan path (R265-R266) exactly as it is.
## Where it lands
Files: `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` (`probe_state`, probe stride unchanged), `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` (`malformed_actions` and neighbors). SPEC sections: §10.6 (prompts), §9.3 and R79 (prompt blocks), R265 (mulligan).
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] New tools unit test: a forged Play during an open prompt is refused, with no events and a byte-identical state; same for EndTurn.
- [ ] The fuzz gate (`fuzz --seeds 200` at least) and the handicapped wave stay green; Duos fuzz is untouched.
- [ ] No new numbers: stride and budget constants unchanged (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
## Size and risks
Small to medium work, suggested `difficulty:medium` (test tooling plus a testkit helper, no engine rule change). Risk is probe noise on exotic prompts; the owed-refusal contract (`judge_probe`) is already the standard all other probes meet.
```
